questions.question: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the first ______________ train service, which includes the Z-Morh Tunnel and the world's highest railway bridge over the Chenab River.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Delhi-Srinagar**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The **Delhi-Srinagar Vande Bharat Express** was inaugurated by **PM Modi** on **Republic Day, January 26, 2025**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **Rapid project progress**: The **Udhampur-Srinagar-Baramulla Rail Link (USBRL)** is nearing completion, with work progressing quickly and expected to finish by early 2025.
 
• **Modern train features**: The Vande Bharat Express will offer **high-speed connectivity**, modern amenities like **automatic doors**, **reclining seats**, and **advanced safety systems**, with **special facilities** for differently-abled passengers.
 
• **Boost to tourism**: This new route is expected to significantly **enhance tourism** in **Jammu and Kashmir**, providing an affordable and efficient travel option.
 
• **Challenging terrain conquered**: The **Banihal-Srinagar stretch**, previously the most difficult part, is nearly completed, marking a major milestone in the rail link project.

questions.question: What is the name of the indigenous semiconductor chip developed by ISRO and IIT Madras for space-based applications?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**IRIS.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

 
• **ISRO and IIT Madras jointly developed **IRIS (Indigenous RISCV Controller for Space Applications)** for India's space missions.**
 
• IRIS is based on the **SHAKTI processor** baseline, a RISC-V-based open-source architecture.
 
• It is designed to enhance India's self-reliance in **semiconductor development** for space applications.
 
• ISRO Chairman **V Narayanan** emphasized IRIS's importance for future **embedded space controllers**.

questions.question: What is the minimum monthly pension provided by the Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maandhan (PM-SYM) scheme after the age of 60?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**₹3,000**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maandhan (PM-SYM), is a voluntary and contributory pension scheme launched by the Government of India to provide social security to unorganised workers. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maandhan (PM-SYM)** is a **voluntary** and **contributory pension scheme** launched by the Government of India for **unorganised workers**.
 
• The scheme guarantees a **minimum monthly pension of ₹3,000** after the age of **60** for workers earning **up to ₹15,000** per month.
 
• **PM-SYM** was introduced in the **Interim Budget 2019**.
 
• It is administered by the **Ministry of Labour and Employment**, in collaboration with **Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC)** and **Common Service Centres (CSCs)**.
 
• **LIC** is responsible for **pension pay-outs** and acts as the **Pension Fund Manager**.
 
• **Enrolment** in the scheme is facilitated through **Common Service Centres (CSCs)** across India.
 
• **Exit and Withdrawal Provisions:**
 
 
• **Exit Before 10 Years:** Refund of the contributed amount with **savings bank interest rate**.
 
• **Exit After 10 Years but Before 60 Years:** Return of contributions with **accumulated interest** (either actual or savings bank interest rate, whichever is higher).
 
• **Death Before 60 Years:** The **spouse** can either continue the scheme or withdraw the contributed amount with interest.
 
• **Death After 60 Years:** The **spouse** receives **50%** of the pension as a family pension.
 
• After the death of both the subscriber and spouse, the **entire corpus is credited back to the fund**.
 
• **In case of default** (non-payment of contributions): The subscriber can **regularize their contribution** by paying the outstanding dues and **penalty charges**, if any.

questions.question: Which of the following Parts is related to the Directive Principles of State Policy?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Part IV**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Part IV **of the Indian constitution is related to the** Directive Principles of State Policy. **
 
• **Directive Principles of State Policy(Article 36 to 51): **
 
 
• **Dr B.R. Ambedkar** who is the father of the constitution said that the **Directive Principles of State Policy** is a **‘novel feature’ **of our Constitution.
 
• It was **classified** into **three major segments**.that are **Gandhian, Socialistic, & liberal intellectual**.
 
• **DPSP **were basically introduced to **establish a ‘welfare state’** in India.
 
• Its vision was to **promote **the **idea** of **economic** & **social** democracy. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Part IV A - **Deals with** Fundamental duties. **
 
• **Part V - **Deals with** duties & functions **of the** Prime minister, President, Vice President, etc. **
 
• **Part VI - **Deals with** **duties & functions of Governor, State legislature, High court, etc.

questions.question: What is India's projected GDP growth rate for FY 2025 as per the Economic Survey?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 6.4%

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• India’s real GDP growth for FY26 is projected to be between 6.3% and 6.8%, suggesting sluggish economic conditions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **Slower Growth in FY25**: GDP growth is expected to slow to **6.4% in FY25, **the lowest in four years, mainly due to weak manufacturing and investment.
 
• **Growth Aspirations**: India aims for an 8% growth rate to achieve its goal of becoming a developed nation by 2047.
 
• **Challenges**: Global factors like geopolitical tensions, the Russia-Ukraine conflict, and global inflation could impact growth.
 
• **Investment Activity**: Public capital expenditure and improving business expectations are expected to boost investment, though challenges like global overcapacity in sectors like steel may temper gains.
 
• **Slowing Economy**: Concerns are rising due to slowing economic activity, with a 5.4% GDP growth in Q2 FY25, down from 8.1% last year.

questions.question: What is the full form of ACADA, the system procured by the Indian Army for chemical detection?

options.text: Automatic Chemical Agent Detection and Alarm

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Automatic Chemical Agent Detection and Alarm.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The Indian Army signed an ₹80 crore contract with L&T to procure 223 ACADA systems.
 
• **These systems detect chemical warfare agents and toxic industrial chemicals in the environment.**
 
• The deal was signed under the Buy Indian category to support Atmanirbhar Bharat.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **ACADA stands for Automatic Chemical Agent Detection and Alarm.**
 
• Over 80% of components will be sourced locally, boosting India’s defense sector.
 
• The system enhances CBRN (Chemical, Biological, Radiological, and Nuclear) defense capability.
 
• ACADA helps in disaster relief operations related to industrial chemical hazards.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• CBRN Defense__

 __
 
• CBRN refers to Chemical, Biological, Radiological, and Nuclear threats in military operations.
 
• Specialized units handle decontamination, detection, and response measures.
 
 
 
• Atmanirbhar Bharat Initiative__
 __
 
• Government’s self-reliance campaign to boost domestic defense production.
 
• Encourages procurement from Indian companies to reduce dependence on foreign imports.
 
 
 
• Larsen & Toubro (L&T)__
 
 
• One of India's leading defense and engineering firms.
 
• Specializes in defense systems, shipbuilding, and infrastructure projects.
